title: Recursion
instructions: Recursion is a function that calls ITSELF. It sounds strange, but it's great for problems that break into smaller copies of themselves.
Every recursion needs a base case — a simple situation that stops it. Without one, it calls forever and crashes.
Here the base case is: when n is 1 or less, just return 1. Otherwise, return n * factorial(n - 1).
task: Fill in the recursive call so factorial(4) prints 24.
hint:
Call the function on the smaller number:

    return n * factorial(n - 1);
